brief:
Amnesty International has called on the UK government to stop an Israeli organisation from promoting West Bank settlements during its tour of the country, Middle East Eye reported. Shivat Zion, whose website encourages people from abroad to relocate to illegal settlements, is currently conducting events across the UK.

The rights group's demand centres on the organisation's active recruitment efforts abroad, which facilitate migration to settlements the international community considers illegal under international law.
